title: SCHC retry budget ignores regular-fragment repair and timeout rounds
description: Post-fix correctness review: retry attempts increment only when All-1 is missing. Regular-fragment-only C=0 repair and repeated timeout ACK Requests can run forever while refreshing session TTL. Count every emitted repair/ACK-request round, abort exactly once at MAX_ACK_REQUESTS, remain terminal thereafter, and add regular-only NACK plus timeout exhaustion tests.
